headings.title: Abolition of writs of error in civil actions
headings.reviewNote: Abolishes writs of error in civil cases and provides review by appeal as a continuation of the trial court proceeding.

headings.title: Inapplicability to criminal proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that this section is not intended to apply to criminal cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; abolition of civil writs of error in favor of appeal and inapplicability to criminal cases verified.

headings.title: Appeal by special order within six months of final judgment
headings.reviewNote: Permits appellate court by special order within six months of final judgment to allow late notice of appeal upon motion, notice, and showing of merit without culpable negligence.

headings.title: Appellate stay authority and protection of third-party rights
headings.reviewNote: Lodges stay authority exclusively in the appellate court with trial-court supersedeas bond filing under sections 512.080 and 512.100, and protects good-faith nonparty rights acquired before filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; six-month appellate special-order appeal, exclusive appellate stay authority, supersedeas bond references (sections 512.080 and 512.100), and good-faith nonparty protection verified.

headings.title: Required contents of notice of appeal
headings.reviewNote: Requires the notice of appeal to specify appealing parties, designate the judgment or order appealed from, and name the appellate court.

headings.title: Trial court clerk notification and transmission duties
headings.reviewNote: Requires trial clerk to mail notice copies by registered mail to other parties without failure affecting appeal validity, transmit copy and docket fee to appellate clerk, and file a mailing memorandum.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; mandatory notice-of-appeal contents and trial clerk registered-mail notification and docket-fee transmission duties verified.

headings.title: Stay of execution for governmental entities, fiduciaries, or on approved bond
headings.reviewNote: Stays execution automatically for listed fiduciaries and governmental entities, or upon court/clerk approval of a supersedeas bond within the prescribed time, releasing prior execution.

headings.title: Supersedeas bond conditions and calculation of amount
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes supersedeas bond conditions, calculation standards for money and property/foreclosure judgments, good-cause modification authority, and surety address requirement.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; automatic execution stays for fiduciaries and municipalities, approved supersedeas bond procedures, and bond conditions/calculation formulas verified.

headings.title: Fifty-million-dollar appeal bond cap in tobacco master settlement litigation
headings.reviewNote: Caps collective appeal bond or surety at fifty million dollars for tobacco master settlement agreement signatories, successors, and affiliates while preserving judicial discretion to set lower amounts.

headings.title: Rescission of bond cap for asset dissipation and financial disclosure duties
headings.reviewNote: Permits rescission of the bond cap and protective orders upon preponderance proof of purposeful asset dissipation, and mandates initial/quarterly asset-liability disclosures and a non-dissipation agreement.

headings.title: Applicability to pending cases on or after August 28, 2003
headings.reviewNote: Applies this section to all cases pending on or after August 28, 2003.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections and statutory history; $50 million collective appeal bond cap in tobacco master settlement litigation (section 196.1000), rescission for asset dissipation, and August 28, 2003 applicability verified.

headings.title: Fifty-million-dollar collective appeal bond cap in tort actions
headings.reviewNote: Caps collective appeal bond or surety at fifty million dollars in cases containing a tort count while preserving judicial discretion to set lower amounts for good cause.

headings.title: Rescission of tort bond limitation for asset diversion and disclosure duties
headings.reviewNote: Permits rescission of the bond cap and protective orders upon preponderance proof of purposeful asset dissipation, and requires initial/quarterly asset-liability statements and written or on-record non-dissipation agreement.

headings.title: Applicability to judgments entered on or after August 28, 2005
headings.reviewNote: Applies this section to all judgments entered on or after August 28, 2005.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections, statutory history, and section 538.305 cross-reference note; $50 million collective tort appeal bond cap, rescission/disclosure rules, and August 28, 2005 judgment applicability verified.

headings.title: Filing deadlines for appellate transcript and trial court copy
headings.reviewNote: Requires appellant to prepare and file the appellate transcript within section 512.130 and 512.140 deadlines and file a copy with the trial court clerk within five days thereafter.

headings.title: Scope of transcript record, evidence inclusion, and abbreviated transcripts
headings.reviewNote: Requires transcript to contain record and evidence needed for review, permits taxing unnecessary-matter costs, and allows written agreement on abbreviated transcripts or a section 512.120 statement.

headings.title: Transcript approval, correction of omissions, and supplemental records
headings.reviewNote: Specifies when trial-court approval is required, directs correction of material omissions or misstatements, and permits appellate orders for supplemental transcripts or original exhibits.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections and statutory history; appellate transcript filing deadlines (sections 512.130 and 512.140), record scope and abbreviated transcripts (section 512.120), and approval/correction/supplemental record procedures verified.

headings.title: Appellate court rules for briefs, filing times, and hardship modifications
headings.reviewNote: Empowers appellate courts to adopt rules on briefs, service, docketing, and transcript cost taxation, permitting suspension or modification for justice and especially for poor persons.

headings.title: Precedence of appellate docketing rules over statutory hearing preferences
headings.reviewNote: Provides that appellate docketing and argument rules adopted under subsection 1 prevail over statutory hearing-order or preference provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; appellate rulemaking for briefs/service/docketing with hardship modification for poor persons and precedence over statutory hearing preferences verified.

headings.title: Preservation requirement for appellate review of trial errors
headings.reviewNote: Bars appellate consideration of allegations of error not presented to or expressly decided by the trial court, except subject-matter jurisdiction and pleading sufficiency.

headings.title: Material error requirement for appellate reversal
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits appellate reversal unless the court believes trial-court error was committed against appellant materially affecting the merits.

headings.title: Appellate disposition powers and award of new trial
headings.reviewNote: Directs appellate court to examine transcript and affirm, reverse, order new/partial trial, or enter judgment, disposing finally unless justice requires otherwise.

headings.title: Discretionary appellate damages and partial affirmance interest
headings.reviewNote: Permits appellate court on affirmance or dismissal to award respondent just damages up to ten percent of the judgment, and specifies lawful interest on partially affirmed judgments.

headings.title: Execution of appellate determinations and remand to trial court
headings.reviewNote: Permits appellate court to award execution directly or remand the cause with decision to the trial court for execution.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 5 subsections, statutory history, and 1986 Swanigan v. Crochett annotation; revised subsection 4 title to remove unstated 'delay' limitation and preserve permissive damages language.

headings.title: Trial de novo in municipal and chapter 482 or 535 cases
headings.reviewNote: Grants a right of trial de novo from non-jury associate circuit judgments (excluding probate and circuit-procedure assignments) in municipal court and chapter 482 or 535 cases.

headings.title: Record requirement and direct appeal in contested associate circuit cases
headings.reviewNote: Requires a stenographic or electronic/magnetic/mechanical sound or video record and permits direct appeal on that record in other contested civil, misdemeanor, and county ordinance cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; revised subsection 1 title to reference chapters 482 and 535 directly and refined subsection 2 note to reflect statutory recording options.

headings.title: Application deadline, notice service, and recognizance for trial de novo stay
headings.reviewNote: Requires perfecting section 512.180(1) trial de novo by filing application within ten days, clerk notice within fifteen days, and approved recognizance within ten days to stay execution.

headings.title: Governing rules for appeals to court of appeals or supreme court
headings.reviewNote: Provides that appeals to the court of appeals or supreme court are governed by the same rules applicable to appeals from circuit judge judgments.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, statutory history, and effective date 1-01-87; ten-day trial de novo application, fifteen-day notice, stay recognizance, and appellate-rule parity verified.
